objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types, subject to versioning, release, distribution and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid the document belongs to.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Current version number of the document, incremented on each revision.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable duration (default 3 years) after which validity must be re-checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 10 years) for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope or areas of validity for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References to other documents or master data linked to this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational areas for which the document is valid.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment, maintained independently but released with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment following the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-critical information object attached to a document, not subject to a formal release cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state controlled via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, managed separately without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expiry, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate a document and archive it, triggering withdrawal of authorizations and archiving process.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its status and authorizations.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign collective authorizations and distribution memberships.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process controlling the steps of creation, review, release, validity extension, override, reactivation, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow task.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document for distribution by email or for acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity such as a department or location that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific filing.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant in a multi-client system where document visibility can be controlled per client.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific view displaying relevant documents and evaluation information.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report providing filtered information about documents in the system.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report such as Status Report, Document Monitoring, Acknowledgement Status.

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Configurable parameters and criteria used to filter report results.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of a document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the process for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when revisions or changes occur.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting its version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting its version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is marked as completed by the author, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser or release participants confirm the document remains valid, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, its status set to invalidated, and archiving begins with revocation of authorizations.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by the Business Admin group to re-validate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is reactivated, restoring a new version with previous metadata, authorizations and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to confirm acknowledgement of a released document version.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Authorizations for a document are revoked at user group and person level during archiving.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version of a document is checked and released via workflow.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to involved users about workflow tasks, status changes and pending actions.

o2o.description: An attachment belongs to and is versioned together with a main document.
Additional information is supplementary content attached to a document.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request references the archived document to be reactivated.
One or more templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating documents.
Documents can be linked to business processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to organizational units.
Documents can be linked to risks.
Documents can reference other documents via the References attribute.
A distribution list is maintained per document specifying user groups and persons for distribution.
User groups are assigned to a document's distribution list for email or acknowledgement distribution.
Individual persons can be assigned directly to a document's distribution list.
Users are assigned to user groups which grant collective authorizations.
In a multi-client system, document visibility is controlled per client.
